title: position
description: The position memo of phase P2 (Implementation Decisions 10, position): what the critic returns after reading only the dossiers, INTAKE.md, and GOAL.json, and from which code renders research/POSITION.md. The schema holds the shape; wayline.position holds the rest: every prior-work row's reference is resolved by the scout and a row that is not existence: verified is dropped with a note, the three directions are ranked by their distance from the intent, and none lies beyond the project's radius.

intent.description: the intent as INTAKE.md states it, in one sentence of your own

prior_work.description: the closest prior work, nearest first; only works you read about in a dossier, never one you remember

reference.description: the dossier's slug (the directory under research/refs/), or for a work a dossier cites but no dossier holds, its DOI, arXiv id, or exact title; the harness has the scout resolve it and drops a row it cannot verify

reports.description: what the work reports, in a sentence, as its dossier says it

bearing.description: what it means for the intent: the same question, a competing explanation, a method to reuse, a result that makes the intent moot

locator.description: where in the dossier you read it (research/refs/<slug>/dossier.md#Results, dossier.json#abstract), or null

feasibility.description: whether the intent can be carried out with the compute and the data INTAKE.md states

compute.description: the compute stated, and what the work needs of it

data.description: the data stated, and whether it can answer the question

reasoning.description: why, in a paragraph; name what the intake leaves unsaid
why, with the numbers you read and where

revised_target.description: a target to propose instead, required when the verdict is out_of_reach and null when it is reachable; the goal itself is the owner's to change

value.description: the target in GOAL.json's metric and units

why.description: why this number, in a sentence

hostile_review.description: the objections a hostile reviewer would raise against the intent as stated, worst first, each one sentence or two

directions.description: three directions the project could take, nearest to the intent first, none farther than the project's radius

distance.description: how far from the intent, on the radius's own scale

title.description: the direction in a few words

text.description: what it would do, and what it would show, in two or three sentences
